fact: LEAP's own history says it moved to electronic payments in Q3 2013 through AYA Technologies, MTN Mobile Money and GhIPSS.
LEAP says its 100th payment cycle in February 2026 reached all 216 MMDAs and over 350,000 households.
LEAP says that in April 2026 it used the Ghana National Household Registry to identify 400,000 newly eligible households for enrolment.

The Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection says LEAP cash-grant disbursement, a government social transfer paying about 350,580 households in its 99th cycle from 22 December 2025, increasingly runs on mobile-money-enabled G2P rails.
source_slug: 2025-12-22 Government begins 99th cycle of LEAP cash-grant payments

fact: The Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection said on 9 October 2025 it has a partnership with GhIPSS to implement the Ghana Pay mobile money payment system for LEAP, giving beneficiaries multiple cash-out options.

The Office of the Special Prosecutor and the Controller and Accountant General's Department report that government employees' salaries are paid by payroll into their bank accounts, with banks directed to withhold affected persons' salaries from January 2024.
